page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.13xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 52 dedicated physical cores and 52 vCPUs, maintaining a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. It is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and low memory-to-vCPU ratio position this instance as a resource-dense option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage.

The ecs.c6t.13xlarge is designed for high-compute workloads. Suitable use cases include batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive scientific simulations where dedicated CPU execution resources are prioritized over large memory allocations or local storage.
